faqs.question: Does Epson have a program where I can donate my working electronic equipment?
faqs.answer:
Yes. Epson America, Inc. and
Digitunity
have joined together with the goal of helping those who are facing economic challenges or have a disability to gain access to today's technology. With your donation, you not only help the environment, but you also help change the lives of those who need these products the most.

faqs.question: How do I change the lock-out mode settings?
faqs.answer:
See
Changing the lock-out mode setting
in the Reference Guide.

faqs.question: Can the Control Panel buttons be locked?
faqs.answer:
You can restrict the use of buttons on the control panel using the Lock-out mode. In the default Lock-out mode, you can use only the Pause, Load/Eject, and Tear off buttons.
To turn the Lock-out mode on and off, see
Turning on or off the lock-out mode
in the Reference Guide.

faqs.question: How do I reset my product?
faqs.answer: To reset the printer's EEPROM, hold down the Load/Eject, LF/FF, and Pause buttons while turning on the printer. The printer beeps once, and restores its factory default settings.

faqs.question: Can I change my product's default settings from the computer?
faqs.answer:
Yes, you can use the
EPSON Remote Configuration Manager
to change the printer's default settings from the computer.

faqs.question: My product starts printing too high or low on the page. How can I adjust the starting point of the print job?
faqs.answer:
The Micro Adjust function allows you to move the paper forward or backward in 1/216-inch (0.118 mm) increments to adjust the tear-off and top-of-form positions. See
Using the Micro Adjust Function
in the User's Guide.

faqs.question: How do I create a custom paper size in the Server Properties?
faqs.answer:
Follow these steps to create a new page size accessible by all printer drivers installed in Windows:
Open the
Printers
or
Printers and Faxes
window.
Click
File
, then
Server Properties
.
Put a check in the
Create a new form
box.
Input a name for the custom paper size.
Under
Paper Size
, enter the desired height and width.
Click
Save
or
Save Form
to add the new form size to the list, then
OK
to close Server Properties.

faqs.question: Can I use the knob on the side of my product to adjust the paper position or to clear paper jams?
faqs.answer: No. Never use the paper knob when the printer is on; this may damage the printer or cause it to lose the top-of-form position.

faqs.question: How do I select bar codes on my product?
faqs.answer: The built-in bar codes are only selectable through software using an ESC code sequence. The built-in bar codes include: EAN-13, EAN-8, Interleaved 2 of 5, UPC-A, UPC-E, Code 39, Code 128, POSTNET, Coda bar (NW-7), Industrial 2 of 5, Matrix 2 of 5

faqs.question: What types of computer interfaces does my product support?
faqs.answer: A computer running Windows 95 or Windows NT 4.0 can be used with the printer's parallel interface.  A computer running Windows 98 SE, Windows Me, Windows 2000, or Windows XP can be used with the printer's parallel or USB interface. Optional interface cards are available to supplement the printer's built-in interfaces and provide added network compatibility.

faqs.question: What optional interfaces are available from Epson for my product?
faqs.answer:
A list of
optional interface cards
is available in the Reference Guide.

faqs.question: What is the recommended duty cycle for my product?
faqs.answer: The specification is 25 percent. Which means the printer is printing (not idle) for two hours per day based on an eight-hour day, 22 days per month.
